Context: D. Mileage Allowance for Journeys by Road :

| 3 and below | Actual fare by ordinary public bus only OR At prescribed rates for autorickshaw for journeys by autorickshaw, own scooter, motor cycle, moped, etc. |  
(ii) At places where no specific rates have been prescribed either by the Directorate of Transport of the concerned State or of the neighbouring States:-  
| For journeys performed in own car/taxi | ~ 24 per km |
